text: DSH LazyGit Plugin 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的可视化 Git 工作台。它在会话输入区提供入口，并在原生右侧侧栏展示仓库界面。用户可以查看文件变更与提交历史、暂存并提交修改、管理分支和贮藏、预览合并并处理冲突，也能让 Git 助手登记分步骤命令提议。适合希望在 DSH 会话中直接审阅和操作当前 Git 仓库的开发者；提交说明生成功能使用 DSH 已配置的模型服务。

DSH LazyGit Plugin adds a Git workbench to DeepSeek Harness Web’s sidebar. Review diffs and history, stage and commit changes, manage branches and stashes, preview merges, and resolve conflicts. Its assistant registers Git proposals; commit message generation uses DSH’s configured model.
想在 DSH 的网页会话里直接查看 Git 文件改动和提交历史。
有没有办法在浏览器里暂存文件、写提交说明并完成提交？
我想在一个界面里切换分支、查看远程状态并推送代码。
合并前能不能先看待引入的提交和文件差异？
Git 合并冲突时，我想并排查看双方内容并编辑最终结果。
如何临时收起部分工作区改动，之后再恢复或从贮藏创建分支？
I want to review diffs and make everyday Git changes from my DSH web session.
Can I preview a branch merge and resolve conflicts in a side panel?
DSH LazyGit Plugin 的功能「仓库变更与历史」：在右侧工作台查看文件状态、差异和提交记录，并通过界面暂存文件、填写说明和提交。
DSH LazyGit Plugin 的功能「分支合并与冲突处理」：合并前预览提交和差异，可选择普通、仅快进或压缩模式；冲突时查看三方内容、编辑结果并继续操作。
DSH LazyGit Plugin 的功能「Git 贮藏」：可对全部或指定文件创建贮藏，并查看其中的文件差异；之后可应用、弹出、删除贮藏或从中创建分支。
DSH LazyGit Plugin 使用前须知：生成提交说明时会把暂存区差异及有限的项目背景交给 DSH 当前配置的模型服务；请在提交前检查生成内容。见 src/host/commit-message.ts:41-61。

dsh-lazygit-plugin README · Git you can see and use：**Understand your repository at a glance.** Browse the commit graph, inspect commit details and file diffs, compare staged and unstaged changes, and see branches, tags, stashes, and remote sync status in one workbench.

**Click through everyday Git work.** Stage files, commit, switch branches, merge, stash, fetch, pull, and push from the interface. Preview changes before merging and resolve conflicts in the built-in three-pane editor.

text: dsh-lazygit-plugin README · Quick start：If you installed `dsh-easygit-plugin` before, stop the Harness backend and run `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-easygit-plugin` before installing the new package below. Existing assistant session links and proposal records are imported once, preserving the original storage and any records already present under the new name. For a manual installation, replace the old mount with the `lazygit` entry in [lazygit.cordis.yml](lazygit.cordis.yml). Refresh the browser after restarting.

dsh-lazygit-plugin README · Quick start：```sh
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-lazygit-plugin@0.5.3
dsh web
```

Open a session for your Git repository, then click the **Git** button beside the composer. The workbench opens in a native right-sidebar tab.

dsh-lazygit-plugin README · Quick start：Use the compact **中文 / EN** control in the title bar to switch the workbench language. Your browser remembers the selection. Switching preserves the current tab and unsaved input; file paths, commit content, and raw Git output remain unchanged.

A typical workflow: **Changes → review the diff → stage files → enter a message → commit → Sync → push**. New branches can set their upstream when pushing.

dsh-lazygit-plugin README · Quick start：If pnpm blocks installation because the package was recently published, add the package to the existing configuration in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml`:

```yaml
minimumReleaseAgeExclude:
  - dsh-lazygit-plugin
```

dsh-lazygit-plugin README · 1. Review, commit, and push：In **Changes**, select a file to review its diff, stage the changes you want, then enter a message or click **AI Generate**. Review the message, commit, and open **Sync → Push**. New branches can set their upstream when pushing.

AI generation requires a configured model and sends it the staged diff and limited project context. Check the generated message before committing.

dsh-lazygit-plugin README · 2. Switch branches, merge, and resolve conflicts：Create or switch branches in **Branches**. To set unfinished work aside, save it in **Stashes**; **apply** restores it while keeping the stash, and **pop** removes the stash after successful restoration.

With a clean worktree, open **Merge**, select a branch, preview its changes, and choose a merge method. Fetch first when using a remote branch. If conflicts occur, edit the result in **Conflicts**, then **save → mark resolved → continue**.
section: 2. Switch branches, merge, and resolve conflicts

text: dsh-lazygit-plugin README · 3. Fix an existing commit：Open **Changes → Commit edits** to edit the latest message, add staged changes to the latest commit, or undo it while keeping your changes. These actions rewrite history, so check whether the commit has already been pushed. To reverse a commit with a new commit, select it in **History** and choose **Revert this commit**; this requires a clean worktree and index.

dsh-lazygit-plugin README · 4. Use the Git assistant for complex operations：Open **Suggestions → Expand Git assistant chat** and describe your goal. Review the proposed commands and risks, then confirm execution. Multi-step proposals stop at the first failure. You can ask the assistant to analyze failures; proposed repairs also require confirmation.

`npm run check` runs type checks, tests, and build reproducibility checks. Git integration tests create temporary repositories for repository operations and recovery scenarios.

CI also runs `npm run test:dsh` against all versions covered above, including earlier tested releases. To reproduce one version locally:

dsh-lazygit-plugin README · Development：```sh
npm install --prefix /tmp/lazygit-dsh-check @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.5
DSH_INSTALL_DIR=/tmp/lazygit-dsh-check npm run test:dsh
```

The smoke test uses and cleans up a temporary DSH_HOME and Git repository. It does not read existing sessions or call a model.

dsh-lazygit-plugin README · Git 可视化，操作更简单：| 功能区 | 可以做什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 变更 | 按目录树浏览文件；用双行号和逐块独立横向滚动审阅 Diff，或切换原始 Diff；暂存、取消暂存单个或全部文件；手写多行提交说明，或点击「AI 生成」填写约定式提交说明。 |
| 提交记录 | 浏览提交图、说明、父提交、变更文件及 Diff；修改、撤销或 Revert 提交。 |
| 分支 | 搜索、新建、切换和删除本地分支；查看远程分支与标签。 |
| 合并分支 | 预览待引入提交与文件改动；选择普通合并、仅快进或压缩合并。 |
| 冲突解决 | 对照当前方、传入方与结果；逐块选择一方、保留双方或手动编辑；保存、标记解决并继续。 |
| 贮藏 | 贮藏全部或指定文件，按需包含未跟踪文件；审阅、应用、弹出、删除或从贮藏创建分支。 |
| 同步 | 查看上游和领先/落后数量；获取更新、仅快进拉取、推送、设置上游，以及管理 Rebase。 |
| 建议 | 与独立 Git 助手对话；审阅命令、原因和风险；逐步执行提议或复制后手动执行；分析失败原因并审阅修复建议。 |

text:
dsh-lazygit-plugin README · 快速开始：需要 Git、Node.js `>=24.9.0` 和 DeepSeek Harness Web。

如果之前安装过 `dsh-easygit-plugin`，请先停止 Harness 后端，执行 `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-easygit-plugin`，再按下方命令安装新包。已有助手会话关联和提议记录会自动导入一次，保留旧存储，也不覆盖新名称下已有的记录；手动挂载的用户还需将旧挂载替换为 [lazygit.cordis.yml](lazygit.cordis.yml) 中的 `lazygit` 条目。重启后刷新浏览器即可。

```sh
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-lazygit-plugin@0.5.3
dsh web
```

打开 Git 仓库对应的会话，点击输入框旁的 **Git** 按钮，即可在原生右侧标签页中打开工作台。

dsh-lazygit-plugin README · 快速开始：标题栏右侧的 **中文 / EN** 小按钮可切换工作台界面语言，浏览器会记住你的选择。切换时保留当前页签和未提交的输入；文件路径、提交内容与 Git 原始输出保持原文。

日常提交只需：**变更 → 审阅 Diff → 暂存文件 → 填写说明 → 提交 → 同步 → 推送**。新分支可以在推送时设置上游。

如果 pnpm 因包刚发布而暂缓安装，可在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的现有配置中加入：

```yaml
minimumReleaseAgeExclude:
  - dsh-lazygit-plugin
```

dsh-lazygit-plugin README · 1. 审阅、提交与推送：在 **变更** 页选择文件查看 Diff，暂存本次改动，填写提交说明或点击 **AI 生成**。检查说明并提交后，进入 **同步 → 推送**；新分支可在推送时设置上游。

AI 生成需先配置模型，会将暂存差异与少量项目背景发送给该模型，生成结果请在提交前检查。

dsh-lazygit-plugin README · 2. 切换分支、合并与解决冲突：在 **分支** 页新建或切换分支。手头改动暂不提交时，可先用 **贮藏** 保存；恢复时，**应用** 保留贮藏，**弹出** 在恢复成功后删除贮藏。

工作区干净后，进入 **合并分支**，选择分支、预览改动并选择合并方式。使用远程分支前先获取更新。遇到冲突，在 **冲突解决** 中编辑结果，再按 **保存 → 标记解决 → 继续** 完成处理。
section: 2. 切换分支、合并与解决冲突

text: dsh-lazygit-plugin README · 3. 修正已有提交：在 **变更 → 提交撤销与修正** 中，可修改最近提交说明、补充已暂存改动，或撤销最近提交并保留修改。这些操作会改写历史，请先确认提交是否已推送。若要用新提交抵消某次提交，在 **提交记录** 中选中它并点击 **Revert 此提交**，操作前需保持工作区与暂存区干净。
dsh-lazygit-plugin README · 4. 用 Git 助手处理复杂操作：打开 **建议 → 展开 Git 助手聊天**，描述目标，审阅建议的命令与风险后确认执行。多步提议遇到失败即停止；可让助手分析原因，修复建议同样需要确认后执行。
section: 4. 用 Git 助手处理复杂操作

```
